Representative pattern to follow
- Workflow/bootstrap pattern: mirror the fail-open Semble setup already used by `review_autofix.yml` / `implement.yml`:
  - runtime `SEMBLE_*` defaults
  - gated `setup-uv`
  - gated `Install semble`
  - gated `Build semble index`
- Prompt/runtime pattern: mirror `validate_process.sh` and `review_run_reviewers.sh`:
  - source `semble_helpers.sh` only if present
  - treat missing helper/binary/index as non-fatal
  - build a concise query string from already-available context
  - materialize a bounded Semble block with `semble_query_block`
  - append that block only in the dynamic prompt section

Conflicts / codebase notes
- `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py` does not exist on the current ref, so this issue will need to create it.
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` currently has no Semble support at all:
  - no `SEMBLE_ENABLED` workflow env
  - no runtime `SEMBLE_*` defaults in “Create runtime workspace”
  - no staging of `install_semble.sh` or `semble_helpers.sh`
  - no `setup-uv` / install / index steps
- Important discrepancy with the issue description: `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt` is rendered in two live code paths, not just one.
  - `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` renders it
  - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` also renders it inside the in-poller review-blocked unblock loop
  Because the template will gain `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`, both render sites must supply a resolved value or `scripts/render_prompt.sh` will fail on the new unresolved-placeholder guard.
- `prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt` exists but is still unwired, matching the issue note. It should remain untouched.

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  - Add top-level `SEMBLE_ENABLED: ${{ vars.SEMBLE_ENABLED || 'false' }}`.
  - Extend “Create runtime workspace” to export fail-open defaults such as:
    - `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=false`
    - `SEMBLE_BIN=`
    - `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=false`
    - `SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH=${RUNTIME_DIR}/.semble-index`
  - Extend “Stage workflow support files” so the poller stages `install_semble.sh` and `semble_helpers.sh` along with its existing support files. Prefer optional/main-fallback semantics so older support refs do not break the poller.
  - Add gated `setup-uv`, `Install semble`, and `Build semble index` steps before `bash scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, reusing the same fail-open behavior already present in other Semble-enabled workflows.
- `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
  - Add support for a second standalone placeholder: `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`.
  - Add the same unresolved-placeholder guard style already used for `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}`.
- `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
  - Insert `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` on its own line near the task header, before the longer dynamic context sections.
- `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`
  - Insert `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` on its own line near the task header.
- `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`
  - Insert `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` on its own line near the task header.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
  - Add fail-open Semble helper sourcing.
  - Add local helper(s) to build concise judge-oriented Semble query text and convert it into a bounded block.
  - Wire Semble prefetch into every live judge path in this file:
    - main wave judge (`mode-judge.txt`)
    - stall judge (`mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`)
    - in-poller review-blocked judge (`mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`)
    - inline integration-conflict judge prompt assembly
- `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`
  - Add fail-open helper sourcing and review-blocked query assembly.
  - Pass the resulting `SEMBLE_PREFETCH` into the rendered prompt.
- `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py`
  - Create the focused contract test requested by the issue.
- Explicit non-change
  - Do not touch `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` in this issue.
  - Do not wire or edit `prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt`.

2. Functions or modules to implement
- In `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
  - Extend the existing line-by-line replacement loop so it recognizes `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` in the same “placeholder occupies a whole line” style as `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}`.
  - Extend the post-render validation so a leftover standalone `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` line fails fast with a clear error.
- In `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
  - Add one small Semble-availability bootstrap near the current helper sourcing block at the top of the file.
  - Add local helper logic to:
    - source `scripts/semble_helpers.sh` if present
    - verify `semble_query_block` exists before use
    - build short, context-specific query text from data the script already has in memory
    - return an empty string when Semble is disabled/unavailable so prompt behavior stays intact
  - Update the main wave judge prompt assembly block so `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh prompts/mode-judge.txt` runs with `SEMBLE_PREFETCH` set.
  - Update `invoke_stall_judge()` so `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt` runs with `SEMBLE_PREFETCH` set.
  - Update the in-poller review-blocked prompt assembly block so `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt` also receives `SEMBLE_PREFETCH`.
  - Update `invoke_judge_for_integration_conflict()` to append the same style of bounded Semble block directly in the script, without creating a new prompt file or new consumer.
- In `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`
  - Add equivalent fail-open Semble helper sourcing using `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR`, not the repo-local `scripts/` path.
  - Build a concise review-blocked query from the issue body, PR metadata, changed files / diff hints, and reviewer/editor context already assembled in the script.
  - Ensure `SEMBLE_PREFETCH` is exported into the subshell that does:
    - `cd "${SUPPORT_ROOT_DIR}"`
    - `bash "${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}/render_prompt.sh" ...`
- In the prompt templates
  - Only add the placeholder line.
  - Do not move content into `judge_static.txt` or any other cacheable static prefix builder.

3. Data structures affected
- No persisted JSON, schema, database, or API payload formats change.
- Affected runtime structures are only:
  - workflow env vars in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  - transient prompt strings/files created by the judge paths
  - prompt-template placeholder contract
- New/extended runtime env contract for the poller:
  - `SEMBLE_ENABLED`
  - `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE`
  - `SEMBLE_BIN`
  - `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE`
  - `SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH`
- New prompt-template contract:
  - `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` becomes a required render-time placeholder in:
    - `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
    - `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`
    - `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`
- The inserted Semble text should reuse the existing `semble_query_block` output format (`=== SEMBLE: ... ===` … `=== END SEMBLE ===`) so the shape stays consistent with the rest of the repo’s Semble-enabled flows.

4. API or interface changes
- Internal renderer interface change:
  - `scripts/render_prompt.sh` will now understand `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`.
  - Any caller rendering one of the three updated judge templates must supply `SEMBLE_PREFETCH` at render time.
  - Supplying an empty string is valid; leaving the placeholder unresolved is not.
- Internal workflow interface change:
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` will expose Semble bootstrap state to `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
- No external interface changes:
  - no new `workflow_call` inputs
  - no new GitHub API contract
  - no new prompt file consumers
  - no changes to `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`

5. Potential risks and edge cases
- Hidden consumer risk
  - The review-blocked prompt template is rendered in two places. If either render site forgets to set `SEMBLE_PREFETCH`, the new renderer guard will fail.
- Fail-open Semble behavior
  - The install helper may be missing.
  - `semble_helpers.sh` may be missing.
  - `semble` may not be installed on PATH even after the install step.
  - index build may fail.
  - All of these must degrade to “empty Semble block, normal judge behavior,” not a hard workflow failure.
- Static-prefix caching
  - The issue explicitly wants static-prefix caching unchanged.
  - Do not put Semble content inside:
    - `assemble_judge_static_context()`
    - `judge_static.txt`
    - `pre_assembled_static.txt`
  - The Semble block belongs only in the dynamic prompt section after the static prefix.
- Prompt growth / duplication
